{"id":2075769010,"question_id":3805,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"2 days, 3 hours","timestamp":1784635096,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"140 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2075769010/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Maximize Active Section with Trade I","memory":"140.5 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int maxActiveSectionsAfterTrade(string s) {\n        int n = s.size();\n        vector<int>leftzeros(n), rightzeros(n);\n        int ones = s[0] == '1' ? 1 : 0;\n\n        leftzeros[0] = (s[0] == '0') ? 1 : 0;\n        rightzeros[n-1] = (s[n-1] == '0') ? 1 : 0;\n\n        for(int i = 1 ; i < n ; i++) \n        {\n            if(s[i] == '1') ones++;\n            leftzeros[i] = (s[i] == '0') ? leftzeros[i-1] + 1 : 0;\n        }\n\n        for(int i = n-2 ; i >= 0 ; i--) rightzeros[i] = (s[i] == '0') ? rightzeros[i+1] + 1 : 0;\n\n        int ans = 0;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i < n ; i++)\n        {\n            if(s[i] == '1')\n            {\n                int j = i;\n                while(j < n && s[j] == '1') j++;\n\n                if(i > 0 && j < n && leftzeros[i-1] > 0 && rightzeros[j] > 0)\n                {\n                    ans = max(ans, leftzeros[i-1] + rightzeros[j]);\n                }\n\n                i = j - 1;\n            }\n        }\n\n        return ans + ones;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"maximize-active-section-with-trade-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2355}
